Further, the Commission in Order dated 28 th September, 2016 in Petition No. 30/MP/2014 has observed as under: **Order in Petition No. 132/MP/2018 Page 26 of 29** 27. On perusal of submissions of the Petitioner and Respondent MPPMCL and reply of the Petitioner to the queries of the Commission vide RoP dated 20.12.2018, we observe that though LILO was considered to be only a temporary element at inception, subsequent system studies suggest that the LILO may be continued as a permanent element in order to enhance grid stability. While hearing the plea of the Respondent 1 and 2 to make the LILO a permanent element, APTEL had granted liberty to Respondents 1 and 2 to approach appropriate legal forum vide its order dated 27.03.2018. The prayer of the Petitioner in this Petition is “ . _continuation of the LILO till finalization of suitable alternatives (if any) as may be identified through system studies to address the high short circuit level issue”._ Thus, the Petitioner is similar to that for which liberty was granted to the Respondents 1 and 2 by APTEL. **Order in Petition No. 132/MP/2018 Page 27 of 29** **Order in Petition No. 132/MP/2018 Page 28 of 29** **Order in Petition No. 132/MP/2018 Page 29 of 29**
